injectionGuard.description: Prompt-injection defences. After lower-trust content (tool results, web pages, files, sub-agent reports, background messages) enters a turn, high-risk actions (shell, messaging other conversations, config changes, scheduling) need approval; replies are checked for system-prompt, secret and other-session memory leaks.
